versions.changelog:
Dog Train-O-Matic v1.0.0

- Initial release: Personalized, breed-and-age-aware dog training plan generator
- Supports common behavior issues with week-by-week progressions and breed-instinct appropriate outlets
- Automatically adjusts plans based on progress logs or plateaus
- Includes red-flag screening for cases needing professional referral
- Usable for obedience, socialization schedules, and breed exercise insights
- Emphasizes force-free, positive reinforcement only
